hints.title: Extract Digits Sequentially
hints.text: Extract digits using modulo 10 and integer division by 10 until the number becomes zero.

hints.title: Maintain Running Product and Sum
hints.text: Initialize product to 1 and sum to 0; with each digit d, update product *= d and sum += d.

hints.title: Subtract Sum from Product
hints.text: Return the final product minus the final sum.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def subtractProductAndSum(self, n: int) -> int:
        prod = 1
        s = 0
        while n > 0:
            d = n % 10
            prod *= d
            s += d
            n //= 10
        return prod - s
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting to strings repeatedly allocates memory and is slower than direct arithmetic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterative digit extraction processes digits in logarithmic time and constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement arithmetic extraction using % 10 and // 10 cleanly.
